The Kerch Bridge's third strike, overnight into Thursday, is new and is on the page.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit
stories.label: SHENZHEN • SUMMIT
stories.summary: The three leaders meet on the APEC sidelines at Kylin Villa with nuclear arms control at the top of the agenda, though no agreement is expected.

stories.headline: GTA VI arrives after a 13-year wait
stories.label: WELLINGTON • GAMES
stories.summary: The game launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in a midnight rolling release starting in New Zealand, with a download of up to 212 GB, after an estimated 17.07 million digital pre-orders worth $1.65 billion, per Sensor Tower.

stories.headline: Anthropic debuts in the biggest IPO on record
stories.label: NASDAQ • MARKETS
stories.summary: Shares begin trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT a day after pricing at $83, raising $81.3 billion — the largest IPO ever, ahead of SpaceX's $75 billion in June — at a roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation.
